assertions: The public input accepts opaque item refs, digests, lifecycle and reply state but no feedback text or person fields.
New, edited, explicit deleted/hidden, resurfaced, reply-state-changed and unchanged observations remain distinct.
An item absent from the current bounded window is missing-unresolved and never inferred deleted.
A complete window may only propose checkpoint advancement; the capability never mutates a checkpoint.
Equivalent unordered input yields the same ordered result and digest.
